text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 23,440.8, up 1.68% on the day and 3.02% over the last five sessions, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 1.58% (5‑day gain 2.93%). Advances outpaced declines (395 vs 94) giving a breadth score of 44.4 in a neutral zone, indicating the rally was fairly broad‑based. The Bank Nifty added 0.58% to 55,002.2, also posting gains across the week.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers, adding ₹6,836.81 cr today and a cumulative ₹15,309.51 cr over five days, while Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold ₹3,678.85 cr. The FII streak is five buying days, suggesting strong foreign inflow. In the options market, Nifty’s put‑call ratio (PCR) is 1.93, indicating more put interest, with max‑pain at 23,700 and a call wall at 23,850. Bank Nifty’s PCR is 0.97 (near‑balanced), max‑pain at 55,600 and both call and put walls at 58,000, pointing to limited directional bias.

Watch the 23,362.88 pivot (P) and the 23,284.97 support (S1) on the Nifty; a break below S1 could test the 20‑day moving average (24,027.65). For Bank Nifty, the pivot is 54,876.85 with support at 54,707.35. Key headlines to monitor include continued FII buying, earnings from MCX and SBI, and any impact from global cues such as US Treasury yields and crude price moves.
